system.boundary: Build a Simulink model of a planar rocket flight system from powered ascent through post-burn trajectory and terminal descent or the 350-second horizon.
engineering_objects: Build a Simulink model of a planar rocket flight system from powered ascent through post-burn trajectory and terminal descent or the 350-second horizon.

The model shall couple a time-dependent thrust program, propellant consumption and changing vehicle mass, altitude-dependent aerodynamic drag, gravity and Earth-curvature flight-path dynamics, and commanded-versus-actual pitch dynamics.
Simulate from 0 seconds until a physically implemented terminal event stops the model or 350 seconds is reached.
